template_data.headline_html: Five boxes every applicant must already check.

Illustrated professional man in smart-casual attire holding a clipboard, reviewing a list. Right column: five checklist rows with forest-green checkmark icons and short labels — 'TWO YEARS', 'TAX RETURNS FILED', 'SAM.GOV ACTIVE', 'PRICE LIST', 'DELIVERY PROOF'. Bottom stripe in dark navy with white callout text: 'FIND THE GAP EARLY'. Clean, structured layout with amber and forest-green accents on white grid lines. Footer text: 'William Hill · GSA Focus'.
